data.name: MappingSelectColumnHint
data.value: Select a column on the left, or click Add to create one.

data.name: MappingExternalNameDescription
data.value: Column name in the external file, written to the header row on export. Import matches columns by position, so this is a display name.

data.name: MappingFieldDescription
data.value: Source/target of the value, in 'FieldName.DataMember' format (e.g. Customer.Value). Leave empty to ignore the column on import and write the fixed value on export.

data.name: MappingFixedValueDescription
data.value: Written as-is on export (e.g. a partner code). Used for columns that have no field.

data.name: MappingCodeConversionDescription
data.value: Maps external codes to internal values using a conversion table, which is a normal business module. Export converts internal to external, import converts external to internal. External codes not found in the table are reported as row errors on import.

data.name: MappingFixedLengthDescription
data.value: Used when the CSV File Format field's Delimiter is None (fixed-length format). Values are padded to the column width on export (values exceeding the width are reported as row errors), and sliced by the width on import. Use Zero padding with right alignment for zero-filled numbers.

data.name: SetupTurnMail
data.value: Include turn notification mail (run Mail Setup first for the mail side)

data.name: SetupPageFrame
data.value: Add page links to the page frame

data.name: SetupDdlHeader
data.value: Generated DDL (run to create the tables)

data.name: SetupReloadNote
data.value: Reopen the project to see the generated modules.

data.name: SetupSenderContract
data.value: Add the sender contract (MailSenderContractField) — required for "send as current user"

data.name: SetupGmailToken
data.value: Add a Gmail user token field (GmailTokenField) — only when sending from the user's own Gmail

data.name: SetupUserGroup
data.value: User module (when the sender is the current user)

data.name: SetupUserGroupHelp
data.value: Not needed when mail is always sent from the system address. Declare which fields of the user module hold the address and display name (sender contract) when using "send as current user" on MailField / BulkMailField, or sending from the user's own Gmail.
